newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xinjiang raises gasoline, diesel prices.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinjiang raises gasoline, diesel prices.

text.p: China's northwestern Xinjiang region has raised prices of various gasoline and diesel products, the Market Daily said on Friday.
The Xinjiang regional price bureau raised the ex-refinery price of gasoline, mainly for use by trucks, by 100 yuan to 1,900-2,000 yuan per tonne, the newspaper said.
The ex-refinery price of diesel, mainly for summer use, was increased by 100 yuan to 1,600-1,750 yuan per tonne, it said.
The newspaper did not say when the new prices took effect.
Prices of other gasoline and diesel products had also been adjusted, it said, but gave no further details.
